new_channels.fan_note: cyclic mod 16 (gamma is 180-degree periodic); even indices are exactly H82's 8-direction FAN as a set, so the 8-fan control is an internal sub-fan of the same computation

channel_families.DVA3_<band>_aniso_l<h>: (max-min)/(max+min) of the smoothed semivariance over the 16-direction fan
channel_families.DVA3_<band>_logvar_l<h>: log10 of the fan-mean smoothed semivariance
channel_families.CSA_<band>_cos2reg_l<h>: cos(2*(phi_soft - psi_reg(fold))) with phi_soft the gamma-weighted circular mean direction; continuous, no degenerate-null mode
channel_families.CSA_<band>_dirR_l<h>: weighted resultant length of the fan direction distribution in [0,1]; directional confidence, continuous
